data.one_liner: Shared Flutter widgets for Serverpod authentication, including passwordless OTP and social logins.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready‑made UI components that handle authentication flows with Serverpod, such as OTP login, social sign‑in, and biometric prompts. It wraps image picking and cropping for profile pictures.
use_when: You need a quick, Serverpod‑centric authentication UI
You want passwordless OTP login out of the box
You need social sign‑in widgets that integrate with Serverpod
avoid_when: You are building a custom authentication flow from scratch
You are using a different backend or auth provider
strengths: Includes passwordless OTP and social login widgets
Handles image picking and cropping for profile pictures
weaknesses: Tied to Serverpod; not usable with other backends
Relies on several third‑party image packages
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, import the package, no build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Google sign‑in for any backend

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Full‑featured Firebase auth with many providers
